summary.text: Captain of Meges' Dulichian contingent in the battle at the ships — distinct from Amphion of Thebes, from the Argonaut Amphion of Pellene, and from the Elis captains of the Catalogue.

story.text: When the fight raged where the wall was lowest, the Epeians were led by Meges son of Phyleus, and Amphion and Dracius followed in the press of battle among the stout-hearted warriors.
